name: Free Community Meal
location: Messiah Lutheran Church, 25225 W. Ivanhoe Rd, Wauconda, IL 60084
raw: THE COMMUNITY MEAL, FIRST WEDNESDAY OF EACH MONTH. Join us on the first Wednesday of each month for a FREE Community Meal! sit down meal or carryout. Doors open at 4:55 PM. Meals are served from 5 PM - 6:15 PM and are available to anyone in the surrounding community - you do NOT need to be a Messiah member. 2026 Community Meals dates: October 7, November 4, December 2. (messiah-wauconda.org home page; churchcenter calendar shows Community Meal 4:55-6:15pm first Wednesday)
notes: Free sit-down or carryout meal open to the community, with The Community Meal organization of Barrington. Page has no event-specific URL.
